---
title: "Restructuring Prudential Bank Regulation in the Light of the GFC"
date: "2012-10-05"
categories: ["Economics", "Financial Markets"]
---

‘Restructuring Prudential Bank Regulation in the Light of the GFC’ is the topic of this year’s free [Warren Hogan Memorial Lecture](https://www.alumni.uts.edu.au/page.aspx?pid=696) to be given by Professor Charles W. Calomiris, Henry Kaufman Professor of Financial Institutions at Columbia Business School, a Professor at Columbia’s School of International and Public Affairs, and a Research Associate of the National Bureau of Economic Research.

Charles is one of the most interesting economists working in this important area of public policy. You can register to attend the lecture by following the above link.
